The stock market indices of the app

Source: R/fct_data.R
get_indices.Rd

The major indices of the US, the rest of the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, and the VIX, with their symbols on Yahoo Finance. The label column holds the names, such as "S&P 500", that pick indices in get_history().

Usage

get_indices()

Value

A data frame with a row per index: label, symbol on Yahoo Finance, region ("US", "Americas", "Europe" or "Asia-Pacific"), the currency of the shares in it, and from, the first day to keep, or NA to keep all of the history. The VIX is a measure of the expected volatility of the S&P 500, in percent a year, so its currency is NA. The Bovespa starts in 1995: in the hyperinflation of Brazil before the real, its returns of thousands of percent a year in the money of the time would swamp every analysis.

Examples

get_indices()
#>                       label     symbol       region currency       from

#> 2                 Dow Jones       ^DJI           US      USD       <NA>
